title: Ask MAIN about your own terminal sessions: read one, type into one open in tmux, continue one that is closed
persona: A developer who works in terminals (Claude Code in tmux, Antigravity) and checks on them from the phone. Short phone messages.
goals: Ask main what your Claude Code session in the cc-live-scratch folder (it is open in your terminal, in tmux) was last asked and what it answered.
Have main type into that same Claude Code terminal session so it replies with exactly: SIM-TYPED-OK — it must go into that session, not a new one.
Have main continue your Antigravity conversation from the same cc-live-scratch folder (it is not open anywhere) so that it replies with exactly: AGY-CONT-OK.
script: Ask main about your Claude Code terminal session in cc-live-scratch.
Ask main to type the SIM-TYPED-OK request into it.
Ask main to continue the Antigravity conversation from that folder with the AGY-CONT-OK request.

checks.name: typed into the tmux Claude Code session
